title: Add Toggle Switch
content: Create toggle switch component for boolean settings. Container: relative inline-flex items-center cursor-pointer. Track: w-11 h-6 bg-gray-200 rounded-full peer-checked:bg-blue-600 transition-colors. Thumb: absolute w-5 h-5 bg-white rounded-full shadow transform transition-transform, left-0.5 when off, translate-x-5 when on. Hidden checkbox input for accessibility. Label text alongside. Disabled state: opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed. Focus ring on keyboard navigation. Optional on/off icons inside thumb.

variants.simple: Create an on/off toggle switch component.
variants.detailed: Create toggle switch component for boolean settings. Container: relative inline-flex items-center cursor-pointer. Track: w-11 h-6 bg-gray-200 rounded-full peer-checked:bg-blue-600 transition-colors. Thumb: absolute w-5 h-5 bg-white rounded-full shadow transform transition-transform, left-0.5 when off, translate-x-5 when on. Hidden checkbox input for accessibility. Label text alongside. Disabled state: opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed. Focus ring on keyboard navigation. Optional on/off icons inside thumb.
variants.advanced: Create accessible toggle switch following best practices. Structure: label wrapper containing hidden checkbox + visual toggle. Hidden input: type="checkbox" sr-only, handles actual state. Visual toggle - track: relative w-11 h-6 rounded-full transition-colors duration-200, off (bg-gray-200), on (peer-checked:bg-blue-600). Thumb: absolute top-0.5 left-0.5 w-5 h-5 bg-white rounded-full shadow-md transition-transform duration-200, on state: peer-checked:translate-x-5. Focus state: peer-focus-visible:ring-2 peer-focus-visible:ring-blue-500 peer-focus-visible:ring-offset-2 on track. Sizes: sm (w-9 h-5, thumb w-4 h-4), md (w-11 h-6, thumb w-5 h-5), lg (w-14 h-7, thumb w-6 h-6). With icons: show icons inside track or thumb (sun/moon for dark mode, check/x for on/off). With labels: "On"/"Off" text labels beside or inside track. Loading state: spinner in thumb, disabled interaction. Disabled: opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed on container. Colors: success (green), error (red), warning (yellow) variants. Accessibility: checkbox is the actual control, label wraps entire component, aria-checked reflects state if using role="switch" instead of checkbox. Props: checked, onChange, disabled, loading, size, onIcon, offIcon, onLabel, offLabel. Animation: smooth translate + color transition, optional bounce on toggle.
